_note: Hand-maintained entity-resolution dictionary (PRD section 7). Legal names, site IDs, facility names and zones come from entities.json/sites.json automatically; this file adds what the workbook does not hold as columns: short names, registry numbers, place names and the negative rules proven by evidence.

negativeRules.text: Ion Peak Trading (REG-NO-4128) is an unrelated broker, not IonPeak Semiconductor.
Delta Consumer Plastics is not Delta Capacitor Works; its 2024 packaging trial never became a supply award.

SITE-901.text: Jade HQ SITE-901 is the registered headquarters and does not manufacture; production is SITE-081 (Z01).

SITE-900.text: IonPeak SITE-900 is a research and pilot line using a different process; it is not a qualified source for NovaDrive dies.

SITE-242.text: Harbor Freight's SITE-242 "Harbor Works" is a consolidation/notify-party site for power dies into Aster, not a factory.
